assertions: All twenty-two required negative proofs are typed, present, and passed.
Recovery is exercised at all ten Phase 4 processing boundaries.
Valid artifacts are reused and missing artifacts resume from their direct dependency boundary.
Corrupt derived artifacts are quarantined before deterministic reconstruction.
Upstream changes invalidate only transitive downstream Phase 4 dependencies.
Protected source and prior-phase evidence has identical before and after fingerprints.
Optional analyzer failure cannot invalidate the deterministic Phase 4 corpus.
Incomplete proof inventories and incomplete boundary inventories are refused.
limitations: Synthetic fault injection qualifies recovery mechanics rather than filesystem or hardware reliability.
